bio: Type designer and font engineer from Vadodara, Gujarat, focused on original typeface designs for writing systems of the Indian subcontinent alongside historical and technological research. Holds an MA in Typeface Design from the University of Reading. Worked as an art director at Wieden+Kennedy's Delhi office, then in London for Monotype and Dalton Maag, overseeing typeface production and engineering for clients including Nokia, Intel, and HP. Co-founded Universal Thirst with Gunnar Vilhjálmsson in 2016.
